ci_12_shards_43383271447_20261113.method: Per-file sums of this run's JUnit case times for completed shards (source junit); for the cancelled shards 3 and 10, elapsed time between consecutive results on each xdist worker from the job log, plus, for a test still running at cancellation, the time from its start line to the cancellation as a lower bound (source worker_completion_intervals). A weight is raised to the measured value, rounded up, only when that exceeds the recorded weight by more than 25 percent and is at least 30 s; no weight is lowered. A suspected stall is reported and never becomes a weight.

method: Sum JUnit case times by collected file, with a 0.001-second floor. These are scheduling estimates, not wall-clock predictions or a test allowlist. Untimed collected files use the median known duration; obsolete entries are ignored. Missing-shard observations use elapsed time between consecutive results on each CI worker (first result measured from pytest session start; includes setup, prior teardown and scheduling delay). Unfinished cases use completed local JUnit times listed in source.supplement. Unmeasured prior entries retain their exact values. BC1/G2 additions (2026-11-03) only fill previously unweighted files: sum one complete source per current collected file, preferring run 41707437114, then run 41700664435 for G1 files, then round-2 local with-mode JUnit (macOS Python 3.13, two workers). Exact case-occurrence multisets and pinned XML SHA256 values are checked; 0.001-second floor, no local-time scaling. Completed failures/skips remain timing observations, not evidence of CI success. Original provenance and every existing weight are retained. Follow-up: measured-ratio scaling (2026-11-03) supersedes only the six initial local-source weights with local sum x 2.729, the larger of two observed complete-file Linux-CI/local ratios rounded to three decimals, as authorized by the lead. All other weights and the prior measured provenance remain unchanged.
